videos.title: The Cat Who Joined the Dog Walk 🐈🐕 (That Old Gang of Mine, 1923)
videos.description:
A neighborhood cat decided the dog walk wasn't complete without him — so he followed along, all the way down the street.

Music: "That Old Gang of Mine" — Billy Murray & Ed Smalle (Victor 19095, recorded June 5, 1923). Written by Ray Henderson, Billy Rose and Mort Dixon. Public domain recording.

Addresses, license plates and faces blurred for privacy. Filmed with permission.

#birds #woodpecker #birdfeeder #shorts

videos.description:
"Boots" (1903) by Rudyard Kipling, read by Taylor Holmes. Victor Records, recorded July 8, 1915.

Rendered in code.

videos.title: Downy Woodpecker Hands the Feeder to a Red-bellied Woodpecker 🐦
videos.description:
A little Downy Woodpecker feeds for half a minute, then a male Red-bellied Woodpecker drops in and settles in for nearly two minutes. Natural sound, no music. Filmed and produced by Seiler Asterces.

#birds #woodpecker #birdfeeder #shorts

videos.title: Shine On, Harvest Moon (1909) 🌕 Full Moon on the Radio | Edison Cylinder
videos.description:
Tonight's full moon rising through the oak, and a 116-year-old Edison cylinder drifting in through the static.

"Shine On, Harvest Moon," sung by Ada Jones & Billy Murray. Edison Standard Record 10134, 1909. Words and music by Jack Norworth and Nora Bayes. Public domain transfer from the UCSB Cylinder Audio Archive.

Moon filmed, framed and produced by Seiler Asterces.

#fullmoon #vintagemusic #ed

videos.title: Moonlit Clouds Drifting Over an Old Oak 🌙 Ambient Night Sky
videos.description:
Clouds drifting under a full moon, past an old oak at the edge of autumn. Filmed in real time — no speed-up, just the sky moving at its own pace. Put your phone down for a minute and breathe with it.

🌙 Secrets Are Lies // Seiler Asterces

Longer ambient visualizers on the channel.

#ambient #nightsky #calm

videos.title: I Built a Pinball Game Where You Bounce Off the Moon 🌕
videos.description:
Moon Bounce is gravity pinball played against the moon. Light every star to climb a stage, and when you fall through the flippers you only drop back one. This run starts at the top.

Game designed by Seiler Asterces. Free to play, link on the channel page.

#moonbounce #pinball #indiegame

videos.title: Ember Ascent: 0 to 180, a New Best 🔥 #shorts
videos.description:
One ember, one tap at a time. This run climbs from 0 past Spark, Blaze and Starfire, falls, rises again, and beats the old best of 124 with a new high of 180.

Ember Ascent is a one-tap vertical arcade game of orbits and glyphs. Tap to leap from ring to ring and keep the ember rising.

Play it free: link on the channel page.

Game coded and played by Seiler Asterces.

#EmberAscent #indiegame #mobi
